fact_english: On 12 June 1898 in Kawit, Cavite, the Philippine flag was shown from a front window of Aguinaldo's house; the balcony was added in 1919 (enlarged 1919 to 1921). Ambrosio Rianzares Bautista wrote and read the Acta of the proclamation, in Spanish; 98 people signed it. The band of San Francisco de Malabon played the march, which had no words yet. Who unfurled the flag is disputed (Aguinaldo or Bautista).

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Tiyak: ikalabindalawa ng Hunyo 1898, sa Kawit, mula sa bintana iniladlad ang watawat.
lines.say: Tiyak: ikalabindalawa ng Hunyo mil otsosyentos nobentay otso, sa KAwit, mula sa bintana iniladlad ang watawat.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.say: Noong mil nobesyentos disinwebe lang idinagdag ang balkonahe.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Si Ambrosio Rianzares Bautista ang sumulat at bumasa ng Akta, sa wikang Espanyol.
lines.say: Si Ambrosyo Ryansares Bautista ang sumulat at bumasa ng Akta, sa wikang Espanyol.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Siyamnapu't walo ang pumirma. At ang martsa ng banda ng San Francisco de Malabon, wala pang liriko noon.
lines.say: Siyamnapu't walo ang pumirma. At ang martsa ng banda ng San Fransisko de Malabon, wala pang liriko noon.

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Eh sino ang nagwagayway ng watawat?

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: 'Yan ang pinagtatalunan. May nagsasabing si Aguinaldo, may nagsasabing si Bautista.
lines.say: 'Yan ang pinagtatalunan. May nagsasabing si aginALdo, may nagsasabing si Bautista.

after_text: Ikaw, ka-Indio: kapag nagkamali ka sa harap ng maraming tao, babalik ka ba para humingi ng tawad?
why_here: The new form: the trivia goes at the END, after the last line of the story, as 'Patalastas ni Usman'.
voice_note: Script trivia line 2 is split in two INDIO lines (the window, then the balcony) and line 3 in two (Bautista, then the signers and the march) so each caption fits; same words. Years voiced as Spanish-derived numbers. 'umungol' must be u-MU-ngol with a soft ng: listen-checked.
